best_season: The most comfortable periods are late spring (April-June) and early autumn (September-October), when temperatures are milder and walking conditions are better.
recommended_days: A typical first visit is 2-3 full days for the main landmarks and museums. Plan 4-5 days if you also want parks, neighborhoods, and slower-paced activities.
budget: For planning, use broad daily estimates per person (excluding flights): budget travel around 45-70 EUR/day, mid-range around 80-140 EUR/day, and higher-comfort travel from about 160 EUR/day upward. Prices vary by season and accommodation area.
